name: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum
role: Ruler of Dubai (2006–present), Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE (2006–present)
summary: Hereditary ruler of Dubai who has driven a state-led, trade-open development model built around free zones, state-owned flagship companies, and national strategies such as UAE Vision 2021 and Centennial 2071. His public statements stress tolerance, women's roles in government, technology, space and innovation, and a managerial style of government. His record on political freedoms has drawn criticism from rights groups and UK court rulings, which are not treated here as his stated positions.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: His economic principles describe a globally open free-market economy and he calls the private sector pivotal, while Dubai also runs large state-owned enterprises under his rule; evidence is mixed so only low confidence.

free-trade.rationale: Presented the 'Economic Principles of the UAE' (2023), whose first principle is a globally open free-market economy, and urged the GCC to ease restrictions on cross-border trade. The long-run benefit to everyone is not stated in those terms.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Announced the UAE Net Zero by 2050 initiative, saying the UAE is committed to cement its climate leadership and backing it with over AED600 billion of renewable investment, framed as an economic opportunity; he has not used language of drastic measures.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: In a statement on the UAE's majlis and tolerance he said all people are equal as they were born and that the country is home to people of every background, free of fanaticism, hate and racial discrimination. Equal rights before the law are not addressed explicitly.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: In My Story he writes that competition is a way of life in government and that without it motivation fades. This concerns individuals and institutions, not peoples in struggle.

space-expansion.rationale: Founded the Mohammed bin Rashid Space Centre (2015) and named the Hope Mars probe, saying people should set no limits to their ambitions; the Mars 2117 settlement plan is not attributed to him personally. Whether space is a central goal of civilization is not stated.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: In 2002 he issued a decree allowing foreigners to buy property in Dubai (designated areas), which set off a real estate boom; this is a record of opening ownership to foreigners, not a statement.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: As Prime Minister he announced and backed the UAE Gender Balance Council (2015), approved its Gender Balance Index for government bodies, and in 2006 issued the law creating the Dubai Establishment for Women Development.

notes: Thin, mostly official-media record: the full text of his books (My Vision, Flashes of Thought) could not be obtained, and sheikhmohammed.ae was unreachable. Federal measures only signed or approved in cabinet (e.g. the 2020 Israel agreement, taken at presidential level) were not counted. Court findings about Princess Haya and Pegasus were not treated as his positions.
